headline: Which sectors Banca Transilvania, the market leader, prefers to lend to more: a fifth of its loans went to trade, production and real estate in H1 2026
summary: Loans to trade, production and real estate in Banca Transilvania's corporate portfolio reached 23 billion lei at the end of H1 2026, up 11% from H1 2025.
why: Banca Transilvania is one of Romania's largest banks, so its sector lending trends indicate credit demand across the Romanian economy.

original_headline: Ce sectoare preferă să crediteze mai mult BT, liderul pieţei bancare. O cincime din creditele date de Banca Transilvania au fost pentru comerţ, producţie şi imobiliare în S1/2026
